name: Starfighter Ship Creator
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: Design your own starship for Starfighter Arena: place vertices on a symmetrical grid with the mouse, then use the generated code to fly it in battle.

descriptions.en: Design your own starship for Starfighter Arena: place vertices on a symmetrical grid with the mouse, then use the generated code to fly it in battle.
descriptions.it: Progetta la tua astronave per Starfighter Arena: posiziona i vertici su una griglia simmetrica col mouse, poi usa il codice generato per portarla in battaglia.
